# QR encoder

`qrcodegen.js` is the compiled JavaScript QR Code generator by Project Nayuki, retrieved October 12, 2026 from https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js . It includes its MIT license. The only local adaptation is the final ES-module export. Vendored SHA-256: `E44F5978AB53D1FA5E6C1618CA9B7908209D4DF8B795251E218B7F4BB18ED485`.

Loaded on demand for local guest QR generation; no remote QR service or runtime package installation. Source/documentation: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library . The dev-only jsQR decoder independently verifies generated QR pixels in automated tests.
